message.content:
A medium‑sized apple (about 182 g or roughly 3 inches in diameter) typically contains around **95 kcal** (kilocalories).  

If you want a quick reference:

| Apple size | Approximate weight | Calories |
|------------|--------------------|----------|
| Small (≈150 g) | ~80 kcal |
| Medium (≈182 g) | ~95 kcal |
| Large (≈223 g) | ~115 kcal |

These numbers assume a standard “red delicious” or “granny smith” apple. Calorie content can vary slightly depending on the variety, ripeness, and whether the apple is eaten raw, baked, or juiced.
